10.label: Management
10.purpose: Firewall, switches, access points and UPS. Only IT gets in here.

20.label: Staff
20.purpose: The Macs of the clinic team.

30.label: Medical devices
30.purpose: X-ray, lab and ultrasound. No internet, only the image archive and the lab server.

40.label: Card payment
40.purpose: Card terminals. Only the payment provider, isolated from everything else.

50.label: Printers
50.purpose: Printers and scanners. They answer print jobs and start nothing themselves.

60.label: Telephones
60.purpose: IP phones, prioritised so calls stay clear.

80.label: vMotion
80.purpose: Moves running virtual servers between hosts. Not routed.

90.label: Storage
90.purpose: Traffic between hosts and the shared storage. Not routed.

100.label: Guest Wi-Fi
100.purpose: Pet owners in the waiting room. Internet only.

hq.label: Berlin HQ
hq.simple: Head office with the server room. All clinics connect to it.
hq.technical: VPN hub. vSphere cluster with 3 hosts, firewall HA pair, two ISPs. Subnets 10.0.x.0/24.

ber.label: Clinic Berlin
ber.simple: Large clinic with X-ray, lab and ultrasound.
ber.technical: Large variant of the standard kit: 2 switches, 4 access points. Subnets 10.1.x.0/24.

hh.label: Clinic Hamburg
hh.simple: Medium-sized clinic, built exactly like the others.
hh.technical: Medium variant of the standard kit: 1 switch, 3 access points. Subnets 10.2.x.0/24.

muc.label: Clinic München
muc.simple: Opening in progress. The IT is planned but not yet live.
muc.technical: Planned from the same template. Subnets 10.3.x.0/24 are reserved.

ext.label: Internet & cloud
ext.simple: Everything outside our buildings: internet, practice software, payment service.
ext.technical: Public internet, the cloud-hosted practice management app behind a load balancer, and SaaS services.

note.isp2: Second provider on a different medium (cable instead of fibre), so one digger cannot cut both.
note.fwVip: The pair shares the virtual address 10.0.10.1; clinics and servers only ever talk to that one.

svc.sip: SIP-TLS and SRTP to the telephone system

rule.mgmtCloud: Network devices report to their cloud management and fetch the time. Nothing else.
rule.mgmtHq: Network devices send status and logs to monitoring at HQ.
rule.staffInternet: Staff Macs may use the internet, including the practice software in the cloud.
rule.staffHq: Staff Macs reach file shares, login and the image viewer at HQ through the VPN.
rule.medicalHq: Medical devices may only deliver images and lab results to HQ.
rule.medicalNoInternet: Medical devices never reach the internet. Vendor support comes in through the jump host only.
rule.posPayment: Card terminals may only talk to the payment provider.
rule.posIsolated: Card terminals are cut off from every other network.
rule.printersQuiet: Printers never start a connection themselves.
rule.voipProvider: Phones may only reach the telephone system.
rule.guestIsolated: Guests reach nothing inside the clinic, and not each other.
